# Escaping probe

Every printable ASCII character except the space, each as its own visible
term and its own `entry=` level. A character needing a mechanism the filter
does not apply breaks this build, or is rejected by makeindex, or fails to
typeset — the three ways an escaping bug reaches a reader. Generated to
cover the range by construction rather than by recall; a literal `!` is
written `!!`, since a lone `!` is a level separator.
